payload.title: README says ARCHITECTURE has a ratchet table
payload.body: README.md:72-74 (Pre-release paragraph) says ARCHITECTURE.md reports where the source diverges from the intended architecture in a ratchet table. Unit ground-documents of docs-and-persona (b4bd37b5) replaced that section with 'How the properties are held': no table, and the gate's pin set ARCHITECTURE_RATCHET is empty. The README sentence is false against the ground document once that lands; the unit that owns README.md should drop or reword it.
